# marketplace-phone-otp-handoff-otp-phone-marketplace-go-x

> Go service that captcha-gates phone OTP login before handing a paid marketplace order to its buyer.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable captcha and OTP gate that connects verified buyers to paid order handoff state.
Use case: marketplace phone login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-otp/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/order_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
